candidates.change_summary: Change oracle() to return address(0) when stored oracle is zero, otherwise return stored oracle (previously always returned stored address cast to IOracleProvider). This can change observable return value when oracle storage is zero.
Return a copy of the stored payoffDefinition without applying transform by removing the transform step in current getter.

Return transformed oracle version by calling _transform on oracle().currentVersion() (was returning _transform(oracle().currentVersion()) unchanged) — change: call oracle().sync() instead of oracle().currentVersion() before transforming.
Change atVersion to call oracle().sync() instead of oracle().atVersion(oracleVersion), so it returns transformed current sync value when asked for a historical version.
Replace the simple interface declaration with a concrete public function in contract C that returns a fixed different string, changing name() to return a different observable value.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function name() external view returns (string memory) { return "MUTATED_NAME"; }

candidates.change_summary: Changed the IProduct.symbol() declaration from a function signature to a concrete public function that returns the C.contract's symbol state variable, altering runtime behavior of symbol() calls.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function symbol() external view returns (string memory) { return C(address(this)).symbol(); }

candidates.change_summary: Change returned controller to cast stored address to IController only if nonzero, otherwise return a default zero-address-cast IController (introduces a different return when storage is zero).
Change maintenance() to return a fixed constant UFixed18Lib.ONE instead of reading stored value, so maintenance(account) always returns ONE.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function maintenance() public view returns (UFixed18) { return UFixed18Lib.ONE; }

candidates.change_summary: Change makerLimit() to return a non-zero constant (UFixed18Lib.ONE) instead of reading stored maker limit.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function makerLimit() public view returns (UFixed18) { return UFixed18Lib.ONE; }

candidates.change_summary: Return a stored utilization curve multiplied by 2 by reading, modifying, and returning its fields (changes returned JumpRateUtilizationCurve values).
Return a cloned struct with makerFeeUpdated flipped (negated) before returning, causing different returned PendingFeeUpdates without changing signature.
Remove the call to emit the MaintenanceUpdated event so updateMaintenance still stores new value but no event is emitted (observable event behavior changes).
Make updateMaintenance require the caller to be contract owner by inserting an extra require that msg.sender equals controller().owner() before updating (changes who can call the function).
Change updateMaintenance to call _updateMaintenance with doubled newMaintenance (multiplies the stored maintenance by 2).

Alter settleProduct modifier to perform no settlement before the function body by inserting an early return after calling settle, preventing the following function from executing its body (changes updateMaintenance behavior when used).
Change onlyProductOwner modifier to check msg.sender equals controller().owner() (no coordinator id lookup) which may allow different callers and thus change who can call updateMaintenance.
